materials.title: Art Drying Lines 006
materials.text: Our paintings are wet. Hang big pictures on the long line. Put small cards on the tray. Write names on the back before hanging. Use two clips for each big picture. Leave the cards in class until tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Your friend takes a big picture to the tray. You say, "____"
options: Hang it on the long line.
questions.explanation: A大画挂长绳；B托盘下面、C水槽均非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend asks where to put a small card. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B小卡放托盘；A是大画位置；C颜料罐会弄湿且非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to hang a picture with no name. You say, "____"
options: Write your name on the back first.
questions.explanation: C挂前背面写名；A擦画无要求；B正面而非背面。

questions.prompt: A big picture hangs from one clip. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A每大画两个夹，已有一个再加一个；B拿绳无关；C不用夹违反要求。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to take a card home today. You say, "____"
options: Take it while it is wet.
questions.explanation: B卡留教室到明天；A湿时带走、C藏外套均不符。

materials.title: Pool Locker Colours 006
materials.text: At the pool, our class uses green lockers. The red lockers are for another class. Keep shoes on the low shelf. Put clean clothes in the locker. Leave the key with the teacher. Walk to the pool; the floor is wet.

questions.prompt: A friend opens a red locker. You say, "____"
options: Put your key in the pool.
questions.explanation: A本班绿柜；B红柜属另一班；C钥匙应交教师。

questions.prompt: A friend asks where the shoes go. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B鞋放低架；A水里不合；C清衣柜不为鞋。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a clean shirt on the wet floor. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C干净衣服入柜；A湿地上、B鞋上均不符合保管安排。

questions.prompt: A friend is about to take the key into the water. You say, "____"
options: Give the key to the teacher.
Leave it in a red locker.
questions.explanation: A钥匙交教师；B丢水中、C留他班红柜均不合。

questions.prompt: A friend starts to run on the wet floor. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B地湿应走；A跑更快相反；C跳柜不相关也非路径。

materials.title: Birthday Candle Wind 006
materials.text: It is my brother’s birthday. We take his cake to the garden. Mum puts candles on it, but the wind blows them out. We go into the kitchen. Dad closes the window. Mum lights the candles again. My brother makes a wish and blows. This time, he blows them out himself. We sing and cut the cake into six pieces.

questions.prompt: The family first takes the cake to the garden.
questions.explanation: A正确：开始take cake to garden；B否认初始地点。

questions.prompt: The brother blows out the candles in the garden.
questions.explanation: B正确：花园里是风吹灭；A错把风的动作归弟弟。

questions.prompt: Dad closes the kitchen window.
questions.explanation: A正确：进厨房后Dad closes window；B与动作不符。

questions.prompt: Mum lights the candles only once.
questions.explanation: B正确：lights again说明重燃；A仅一次不符。

questions.prompt: The cake is cut into six pieces.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句six pieces；B否认明确数量。

materials.title: Red String Books 006
materials.text: I make a bookmark with red string. I tie one end to a small card. I draw a moon on the card. The other end stays inside my storybook. It shows my page. My little brother wants to pull the string. I say, "Please do not pull it." I make him a paper star instead. He puts the star on his toy box.

questions.prompt: The bookmark uses red string.
questions.explanation: A正确：开头red string；B否认材料颜色。

questions.prompt: The writer draws a star on the bookmark card.
questions.explanation: B正确：书签卡上moon；A混淆另做给弟弟的star。

questions.prompt: One end of the string stays in the storybook.
questions.explanation: A正确：other end stays inside storybook；B否认放置方式。

questions.prompt: The writer asks the little brother to pull the string.
questions.explanation: B正确：Please do not pull；A忽略否定。

questions.prompt: The brother puts his paper star on the toy box.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句star on toy box；B与动作相反。

materials.title: Wind Sock Weather 006
materials.text: Our class puts a cloth wind sock on a pole in the playground. The open end faces the wind. On Monday, the sock hangs down. There is almost no wind. On Tuesday, it points towards the library. We stand beside the pole and draw what we see. We do not climb it. A teacher takes the sock down on Friday because strong wind is expected at the weekend. We will put it back after the windy weather.

questions.prompt: The wind sock is made of cloth.
questions.explanation: A正确：cloth wind sock；B否认材料。

questions.prompt: The sock hangs down on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: B正确：周一垂下，周二指向图书馆；A混淆日期。

questions.prompt: The pupils draw the sock while standing beside the pole.
questions.explanation: A正确：stand beside pole and draw；B否认观察方法。

questions.prompt: The pupils climb the pole to take the sock down.
questions.explanation: B正确：不爬杆，教师周五取下；A同时错人和动作。

questions.prompt: The sock will be put back after the windy weather.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句说明天气过后重挂；B与未来安排相反。

materials.title: Tram Stop Garden 006
materials.text: A flower bed stands near the tram stop. People sometimes walk across it to catch a tram. The flowers break, and shoes get muddy. The children draw a map of a short path around the bed. The path takes only half a minute longer. They show the map to the town gardener. She puts three stepping stones beside the flowers, not through them. A small sign points to the stones. After a week, fewer flowers are broken. The children count broken stems on Monday and Friday to check the change.

questions.prompt: Why do some people walk across the flower bed?
questions.explanation: A为赶电车；B无种植动作；C反而鞋变泥。

questions.prompt: How much longer is the path around the bed?
questions.explanation: B半分钟；A半小时、C两小时均夸大时间。

questions.prompt: Where are the stepping stones placed?
questions.explanation: C花旁不穿花床；A明确not through；B车内无关。

questions.prompt: What does the small sign do?
questions.explanation: A指向踏石；B票价、C摘花未提。

questions.prompt: How do the children check the change?
options: They count broken stems on two days.
questions.explanation: B周一周五数折茎；A鞋、C停电车非方法。

materials.title: Snowy Footprint Diary 006
materials.text: Before school, I saw small footprints in fresh snow beside our gate. They ended near a bush. I thought a cat had gone under it. My sister said they might belong to a bird because she could see three thin marks at the front of each print. We did not move the bush or put food there. We drew the prints and measured the distance between two of them with a ruler. After school, the snow was melting and the prints had nearly disappeared. We showed our drawing to a wildlife volunteer. She said the drawing suggested a bird, but she could not be certain without seeing a clear print herself.

questions.prompt: The footprints were first found before school.
questions.explanation: A正确：Before school明确发现时间；B否认时间。

questions.prompt: The writer and the sister immediately agreed on the animal.
questions.explanation: B正确：作者猜猫，姐姐猜鸟；A把分歧说成一致。

questions.prompt: They measured the space between two prints.
questions.explanation: A正确：用尺测两印间距；B否认记录行为。

questions.prompt: The prints were clearer when they returned from school.
questions.explanation: B正确：融雪后印几乎消失；A将变模糊改清晰。

questions.prompt: The volunteer said a bird was possible but not certain.
questions.explanation: A正确：suggested a bird但could not be certain；B否认保留不确定性。

units.title: 课间工具台的借用规则

materials.title: School Tools Deposit 006
materials.text:
Tool desk: lunchtime service
Pupils may borrow rulers, scissors and glue sticks for use in the art area. Write your class and the tool number on the card. Leave your student card with the helper until you return the tool. Do not take tools to the playground. The desk opens at 12:10 and closes at 12:50. Please bring tools back by 12:45 so helpers have time to check them. Tell a helper about damage before borrowing. Do not try to hide a broken handle. If a glue stick is empty, return the whole container; helpers will refill it. The tools are free to borrow, but they must stay at school.

questions.prompt: Where may pupils use the borrowed tools?
questions.explanation: B限美术区；A家中、D校车未许可；C操场明禁。

questions.prompt: What does a pupil leave with the helper?
questions.explanation: C押学生卡至归还；A饭盒、B车票、D钥匙不是规则。

questions.prompt: By what time should tools be returned?
questions.explanation: A12:45前便于核查；B开台时间；C关闭时间而非最迟归还；D超时。

questions.prompt: What should pupils do with an empty glue stick?
questions.explanation: D空胶棒连容器归还便补充；A乱丢、B带家、C灌水均不合规则。

questions.prompt: What should a pupil do on seeing a broken handle before borrowing?
questions.explanation: B借前报告损坏；A明禁藏坏；C拿他人卡、D付司机无关。

units.title: 桥上人数统计的重复记录

materials.title: Bridge Counting Mistake 006
materials.text:
The student council wanted to know how many people used the footbridge before school. Two pupils stood at opposite ends and counted people for fifteen minutes. At the end, they added their totals. A teacher pointed out a problem: a person crossing the bridge could have been counted by both pupils. Their total might describe two observations of the same journey.
The next day, they agreed that one pupil would count people entering from the east and the other would count people entering from the west. They also marked bicycles separately from walkers. This gave them a clearer record of journeys in each direction. They still could not say how many different individuals used the bridge, because one person might cross more than once. Their report called the result "crossings" and explained the method.

questions.prompt: The first method could count one crossing twice.
questions.explanation: A正确：两端可能同数一人一次过桥；B否认指出的重复问题。

questions.prompt: The pupils solved the first problem by adding their totals a second time.
questions.explanation: B正确：改按两端进入方向分工；A重复相加无此行动。

questions.prompt: Bicycles and walkers were recorded separately on the second day.
questions.explanation: A正确：marked bicycles separately；B否认分类。

questions.prompt: The final record proved how many different people used the bridge.
questions.explanation: B正确：一人可多次过，不能证不同个体数；A把次数当人数。

questions.prompt: The report explained how crossings were counted.
questions.explanation: A正确：called crossings and explained method；B否认报告说明。

units.title: 健康课用的空药盒模型

materials.title: Medicine Cabinet Model 006
materials.text:
For a health lesson, the teacher brought empty medicine boxes with all personal labels removed. Pupils used them to practise reading instructions. No real medicine was allowed in the classroom activity. One box said that its contents must be kept away from heat. Another said to ask a pharmacist before using it with another medicine.
The pupils made a pretend cabinet from cardboard. Aria suggested placing it above a toy oven because the space was empty. Her group rejected that position after rereading the heat warning. They chose a cool place for the model and made a separate "Ask an adult" card for any instruction they did not understand.
At the end, the teacher reminded them that a classroom model did not give permission to choose or take medicine themselves. Real medicines needed to be stored by adults and used according to professional advice. The exercise was about noticing a warning and knowing when to ask for help.

questions.prompt: What did the teacher bring to the lesson?
options: Bottles of real medicine for tasting.
A working oven for heating medicine.
questions.explanation: B空盒并去个人标签；A不许真药；C玩具烤箱非实炉；D无隐私病历。

questions.prompt: Why was the place above the toy oven rejected?
options: It was too high for the teacher.
The group considered the warning about heat.
The cardboard had a written address.
questions.explanation: C重读避热警告而拒；A高度、B满载、D地址均未提。

questions.prompt: What did the group do about instructions they did not understand?
options: Made a card reminding them to ask an adult.
questions.explanation: A制作Ask an adult卡；B忽略、C删警告、D试真药均与课旨相反。

questions.prompt: What limit did the teacher state at the end?
options: All medicine boxes must be made of cardboard.
The model could replace professional advice.
The activity did not authorise pupils to choose or take real medicine.
questions.explanation: D明确课堂模型不授予自行选服药许可；A无包装限制；B成人保管；C仍需专业意见。

questions.prompt: What was the main purpose of the exercise?
options: To teach pupils to sell empty boxes.
To notice warnings and recognise when help is needed.
questions.explanation: B末句明确目标；A卖盒、C选价、D建医院均非活动目的。
